# 2 Baruch Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**9:1** And-I Baruch came and-sat-down before-the-gate-of-the-temple and-wept and-mourned, and-I-cried-out and-said: "O-LORD, why-have-you-set-fire-to-your-vineyard and-laid-waste-to-your-land, and-why-have-you-given to-destruction the-plantation-of-your-right-hand?

**9:2** And-all the-prophets-of-your-people who-are-left are-being-led-away into-captivity, and-there-is-no-one-left [here] to-comfort your-servant Baruch."

---

*EMET notes: "Vineyard" = Israel (Isa 5:1-7). "Plantation of your right hand" echoes Ps 80:15. The short lament positions Baruch's solitude as the context for the next revelation cycle.*
